executed_controls.method: Four original recording shell tails, five scenarios each. Git replaced by inert shell function; no actual git commit/push, checkout, credentials, API or workflow dispatch. Authored Python runner reproduces upstream test scenarios, not full Vitest.

findings: All20recording-tail controls propagate diff/commit/push failures and suppress premature success notices. They do not exercise build, upload, review, deployed version or state concurrency.

AMO bootstrap blanktag checks out github.sha but later resolves latest release tag for state. No check binds built version/source to recorded tag on this path. permissions contents:read while recording pushes store-state; successful push depends on additional effective credentials/permissions, not qualified here.

Reusable normal build checks resolved tag against package version but runs build/verify/zip without tests in this workflow. Publisher jobs check out workflow-context source, not the built tag; tool/artifact revision distinction is explicit on staged path, implicit normal path.

Staged path checks full commit and expected content digest, and refuses existing version tag; zip digest remains content equivalence with earlier duplicate-name ambiguity counterexample, not universal archive byte identity.

Credential absence and known review queue blocks may be successful skipped jobs. Recorded state explicitly says public version unverified; green workflow not release/live-runtime proof. AMO external action implementation not inspected here.

Edge Location parsing expects no whitespace after colon and cuts at next colon; conventional Location: operation-id or absolute URL may be mishandled. Static finding only, no API assumptions or network execution.
limits: No production implementation adopted/performance result. Native pHash/ASAN deferred.
